sentences.text: Every sound in the jungle died at once.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Strange crimson lights rippled across the dark sky while the old tales say the watcher wakes.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I came home after years away and slowly realised my relative at home was no longer what they were.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A giant floating bloodshot eyeball with a toothed mouth and trailing nerves hovered by the window.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It made no sound at all as it matched my every step from the shadows.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The creature struck without a warning growl.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Only a dropped lantern and silence remained on the path.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Would you have stopped to listen for the silence?
sentences.speaker: narrator
